mentions.name: macOS perspective correction app
mentions.description: A macOS app that performs perspective correction of images, with unique features, an easy interface modeled on Numbers/Pages/Keynote, and a small 1.1 MB download size.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm just wrapping up a macOS app to do perspective correction of images. It has a bunch of unique features, easy user interface along the lines of Numbers/Pages/Keynote, and a download size of only 1.1 MB.
